subject: AWS marketplace listing: product page copy & procurement snippets
messages:
From: Elaine Johnson <elaine@acmeretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jul 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing kickoff & procurement snippets request

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency/cost slides. We're kicking off the AWS Marketplace listing for the POC and procurement asked for a short set of artifacts so they can start internal approvals. Can you share: 

- Product page copy we plan to use (short blurb + two benefit bullets)
- Short procurement snippets (SLA language, billing footnote, entitlements) they can paste into our contract system
- Any co-sell readiness / partner contact notes for hooking up AWS SPM

We'd like to get a first-pass bundle by end of day Thursday so our legal/procurement can review next week. Attaching our listing template for context.

Thanks,
Elaine Johnson
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Acme Retail
(attachment: acme_listing_template.docx)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Johnson <elaine@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing kickoff & procurement snippets request

Hi Elaine — great to hear the demo resonated. We're on it. Quick plan:

1) Kimberly will share the product page blurb + two benefit bullets and a one-paragraph elevator.
2) Olga will pull together the procurement snippets (SLA, billing footnote, trial entitlements).
3) I'll package everything into a zip with the listing assets and send a short checklist for co-sell readiness with the AWS contact steps.

We should have a consolidated bundle to you by EOD Thursday (07/10). If procurement needs a redline-friendly clause set instead of snippets, let us know and Olga will prioritize.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

Hi all — first pass product copy below (feel free to pull verbatim into your AWS listing):

Title: Redwood Inference — Low-latency LLM inference for production apps
One-liner: Consistent, predictable LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments.

Benefit bullets:
- Predictable performance: dedicated pools and smart routing keep tail latency under strict SLOs for user-facing apps.
- Cost controls: intelligent batching, cache reuse, and quantization recommendations reduce per-token costs without sacrificing quality.

Elevator (1 paragraph):
Redwood Inference is a developer-first inference platform that delivers production-grade LLM serving across hosted API, reserved (Dedicated), and private deployments. Ship features faster with predictable latency, measurable unit economics, and built-in rollouts and observability so your engineering teams can focus on product rather than serving infra.

I've attached a copy in docx and a one-slide visual for the product tile. Olga — procurement snippets to follow.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal PM, Marketplace & GTM
Redwood Inference
(attachments: product_blurb_v1.docx, product_tile_slide.png)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Johnson <elaine@acmeretail.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace listing kickoff & procurement snippets request

Hi Elaine / team — procurement-ready snippets below. These are intentionally short so your legal team can paste into internal systems; if they want full contract language we can provide a redline-ready attachment.

SLA snippet (for listing / procurement):
"Availability: Redwood Inference will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide 99.9% uptime for Dedicated and Hosted API endpoints measured monthly. For outages, Redwood will offer service credits as outlined in the dedicated SLA schedule."

Billing footnote (for marketplace catalog & PO):
"Billing is based on metered usage (per-token billing for generation; per-embedding unit for embeddings). For Dedicated deployments, committed capacity billing applies per the reserved capacity contract. Taxes and AWS marketplace fees may apply."

Trial / entitlements (concise):
"Trial entitlements include up to 100,000 free inference tokens for evaluation; trial customers may self-select Hosted or Dedicated evaluation paths. Production entitlements, data retention, and key management options are documented in the private deployment addendum."

Attachments: I uploaded a procurement_snippets_acme.docx and a pricing_matrix.csv (sample pricing bands) to the shared bucket.

Olga Petrov
Director, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference
(attachments: procurement_snippets_acme.docx, pricing_matrix.csv)

Sean / team — this is excellent, thank you. Procurement reviewed Olga's snippets and asked two quick clarifying questions:

1) Can you confirm the measurement window for the SLA (UTC vs local month)?
2) Can you provide a single line we can include in our purchase order that references the trial token allowance?

If it's quicker, we can take the snippets and modify them internally, but a one-line PO-friendly sentence would help accelerate approvals. Can you send that today?

Best,
Elaine
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Acme Retail
